title: Greer passes along an insider's contact (Jake Barber)

tellings.quote: So he says this gentleman uh knows what you saw but here's his contact information.

plain: In 2023, Steven Greer, a well-known campaigner for UFO disclosure, is said to have handed a witness the contact details of an insider named Jake Barber, telling him that this man "knows what you saw." The witness, Michael Herrera, who says he saw a huge UFO in the Indonesian jungle, tells Michels this himself. It matters because it would mean someone on the inside already knew of Herrera's sighting.
